name: Qi Shen Nong Gui
source: "Deceiving Gods and Ghosts" (Qi Shen Nong Gui) is a female-oriented pixel RPG game set in a fictional matriarchal society. In the game, you will play as a mounted police officer from the Zhenwu Department, freely moving between the jianghu and the imperial court. The official career is full of ups and downs and countless changes. All destinies are for you to decide. Whether you want to act recklessly and meddle in court politics, seek ways to stop conflicts and maintain peace, protect the citizens of a region, or... respond to heaven's will and ascend to the imperial throne.
